Cut the potatoes into chips, soak in cold water, then dry well.Fry the chips in the vegetable oil at a low heat until soft, drain, then fry again at a high heat until golden.Shallow fry the chicken in some of the oil until golden and cooked through.Top each piece with napoli sauce, ham and mozzarella and grill until bubbling.
